layout.realizing_domains: compact panels in a readable grid; capabilities in one vertical list per domain
layout.enabling_domains: compact panels stacked vertically; capabilities in one vertical list per domain
layout.domain_heading: small centered text on a near-white strip; no large dark header
layout.region_frame: none; only individual domain panels have borders
layout.sparse_models: keep the 16:9 canvas, compact cells and balanced whitespace; never inflate cells or add capabilities
layout.cell_flow: one capability per full-width row, stacked top to bottom in every domain on both sides; text stays horizontal

type.family: Noto Sans TC or equivalent clear sans serif

constraints: compact architecture-map composition matching the supplied reference
one independently bordered rectangle per capability
no outer frame around an entire region
no large dashboard cards or oversized region headings
no rounded cards, shadows, gradients, texture, icons or arrows
uniform label size across domains; do not stretch sparse cells
no inherited company labels or source branding
